info.title: Notification Service API
info.description:
Owns Firebase device registrations, user notification preferences, event deduplication, and delivery state. Business services never call Firebase directly; they publish domain events to the Queue, and Notification Service converts supported events into push messages.

The service publishes no events. It consumes the following queue event types: `user.friend-request.created.v1`, `map.proximity.detected.v1`, `guild.invitation.created.v1`, `battle.request.created.v1`, `battle.completed.v1`, `raid.started.v1`, `raid.completed.v1`, and `raid.failed.v1`. Their payload schemas live in the producing services' spec files.

## Behind the API Gateway

The service is reachable only through the API Gateway, under the `/notification` prefix: the gateway strips the prefix and forwards the rest of the path and the query string unchanged. Clients authenticate at the gateway with a bearer token. The gateway verifies it, removes the `Authorization` header and states who the caller is in the `X-Caller-Kind`, `X-User-ID`, `X-Session-ID`, `X-Service-Name` and `X-Scopes` headers. The service never sees the token and trusts these headers only because nothing but the gateway can reach it; a request without `X-Caller-Kind` is refused with `401 MISSING_IDENTITY`.

Each operation lists who may call it in its description and in `x-allowed-callers`, where `owner` is the user who owns the resource. A wrong user is refused with `403 NOT_RESOURCE_OWNER`, a service not on the list with `403 CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED`.

Every request is bounded by a deadline and answered `504 REQUEST_TIMEOUT` when it passes. At most a configured number of requests are served at once; one more is refused immediately with `503 CONCURRENCY_LIMIT_REACHED` and `Retry-After: 1`. `X-Correlation-ID` is kept as received and echoed on every response; for an event, the envelope's correlationId is kept on the notifications it produces.

Through the API Gateway, the only entry point of the deployment

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Domain events delivered by producing services until a broker is deployed

get.summary: List a user's registered notification devices
get.description: Callable only by the account owner; X-User-ID must equal userId. Allowed callers: the account owner.

put.summary: Register or refresh a notification device
put.description: Callable only by the account owner; X-User-ID must equal userId. Uses PUT because the same application installation may safely submit its current Firebase token multiple times. Allowed callers: the account owner.

delete.description: Callable only by the account owner; X-User-ID must equal userId. Allowed callers: the account owner.

get.description: Callable only by the account owner; X-User-ID must equal userId. A missing preference record means that all categories are enabled by default. Allowed callers: the account owner.

put.description: Callable only by the account owner; X-User-ID must equal userId. The request carries the complete category selection. Allowed callers: the account owner.

post.summary: Deliver a domain event without a message broker
post.description: Callable only by the producing services with their service token. Runs the same processing path a queue consumer would: deduplication by eventId, recipient and device, preferences, delivery and dead-lettering. Unknown event types or versions and events naming no recipients are dead-lettered. Allowed callers: User Management, Map, Guild, Battle or Monster Raid Service only.

422.description: Rejected domain operation: UNSUPPORTED_EVENT or MALFORMED_EVENT; the event is dead-lettered

bearerAuth.description: Bearer JWT issued by User Management and verified by the API Gateway. The gateway removes the Authorization header and states the caller in the X-Caller-* headers, so the service never sees the token.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Traces one operation across services and events. Generated by the gateway when absent, kept as received and echoed on every response; for an event, the envelope's correlationId is kept on the notifications it produces

CallerKind.name: X-Caller-Kind
CallerKind.description: Who the gateway verified the caller to be. Set by the API Gateway from the verified token. Clients never send it: the gateway removes any value a caller supplies and sets its own. A request without it is refused with 401 MISSING_IDENTITY, so a request that bypassed the gateway fails closed.

CallerUserId.name: X-User-ID
CallerUserId.description: Authenticated user id, present for user callers. A user id in the path is a parameter, not an identity: ownership is decided by comparing it with this header. Set by the API Gateway from the verified token. Clients never send it: the gateway removes any value a caller supplies and sets its own.

CallerSessionId.name: X-Session-ID
CallerSessionId.description: Session id of a user caller, when the token carries one. Set by the API Gateway from the verified token. Clients never send it: the gateway removes any value a caller supplies and sets its own.

CallerServiceName.name: X-Service-Name
CallerServiceName.description: Name of a calling service, present for service callers and compared with each operation's allowlist. Set by the API Gateway from the verified token. Clients never send it: the gateway removes any value a caller supplies and sets its own.

CallerScopes.name: X-Scopes
CallerScopes.description: Space-separated scopes of a service caller, when its token carries any. Set by the API Gateway from the verified token. Clients never send it: the gateway removes any value a caller supplies and sets its own.

Forbidden.description: NOT_RESOURCE_OWNER for another user, or CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED for a service not on the operation's allowlist

Unauthorized.description: MISSING_IDENTITY: the request reached the service without a complete caller identity from the gateway, or an anonymous caller reached an operation that needs one. Through the gateway, a missing or invalid token is answered by the gateway itself with MISSING_TOKEN or INVALID_TOKEN.

NotResourceOwner.description: NOT_RESOURCE_OWNER: the caller is not the user who owns the resource

CallerNotAllowed.description: CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED: the operation is reserved for the listed services; users, the owner included, are refused

ConcurrencyLimitReached.description: CONCURRENCY_LIMIT_REACHED: the service is already serving its maximum number of requests and rejects the request at once instead of queueing it

RequestTimeout.description: REQUEST_TIMEOUT: the request did not finish within the service's deadline (REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, 4 seconds by default)

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier of the failed operation, as received in X-Correlation-ID or generated for the request

details.description: Optional structured details; for VALIDATION_FAILED one entry per field with its field name and message

fcmRegistrationToken.description: Firebase token for the application installation. Firebase registration tokens are confidential: they are stored only by Notification Service and never returned in responses

packageId.description: Tamagotchi application package registering the token

appVersion.description: Client version used for delivery diagnostics

enabled.description: Whether pushes may be sent to this registration

categories.description: Complete enabled/disabled category selection. Supported categories are FRIEND_REQUEST, PROXIMITY, BATTLE_REQUEST, BATTLE_RESULT, GUILD_INVITATION, and RAID_LIFECYCLE
Effective category settings. Supported categories are FRIEND_REQUEST, PROXIMITY, BATTLE_REQUEST, BATTLE_RESULT, GUILD_INVITATION, and RAID_LIFECYCLE

updatedAt.description: Last preference update; the current time while the defaults were never replaced

eventId.description: Unique event identifier used for deduplication

eventType.description: Stable event name including the version suffix

occurredAt.description: Time at which the business event occurred; the processing time when absent

correlationId.description: Identifier connecting the event to the originating operation

data.description: Event-specific payload carrying the recipient fields
